blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ وَأَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵄ أَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنِّي لأَعْرِفُ أُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بَيْنَ اْلأَُمَمِ، قَالُوْا: يَارَسُوْلَ اللهِ! وَكَيْفَ تَعْرِفُ أُمَّتَكَ؟ قَالَ: أَعْرِفُهُمْ يُؤْتَوْنَ كُتُبَهُمْ بِأَيْمَانِهِمْ، وَأَعْرِفُهُمْ بِسِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوْهِهِمْ مِنْ أَثَرِ السُّجُوْدِ، وَأَعْرِفُهُمْ بِنُوْرِهِمْ يَسْعَي بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Dharr and Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) narrate: When the Prophet ﷺ said, "On the Day of Qiyamah, I will recognise my Ummah among the other nations,' the Sahabah asked, "O Rasulullah, how will you recognise your Ummah?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "I will recognise them by their record (book of deeds) being given in their right hands; I will recognise them by the radiance shining on their faces because of making much "Sajdah; and I will recognise them by a (special) light running swiftly before them.'

blocks.text:
Explanation:- This light is the light of Iman that is in every Mu'min. Each person will receive that light in proportion to the strength of his Iman.
(Kashf-ur-Rahman)
